pageIntro: Manage your account, upload defaults, and security settings.

permissions.rootLinksAlwaysAdmin: Administrators always hold this permission, so it can't be switched off here. It can only be granted or revoked for regular accounts.

themeNote: Your theme is also shown to anyone who opens your links.

default.name: Classic
default.desc: Clean, violet-accented and quiet. The original Modlight look.

glass.name: Liquid Glass
glass.desc: Neutral translucent panels with a lit edge, floating over soft light.

synthwave.name: Synthwave
synthwave.desc: Neon pink and cyan on deep purple.

terminal.name: Terminal
terminal.desc: Green on black console, monospace throughout.

paper.name: Paper
paper.desc: Warm serif stationery, like a good notebook.

win98.name: Windows 98
win98.desc: Beveled grey chrome on a teal desktop.

nebula.name: Nebula
nebula.desc: A real starfield under nebula light, panels lit along one edge.

grimoire.name: Grimoire
grimoire.desc: Parchment and gilt. Old style serif, framed panels, candlelit after dark.

cartoon.name: Cartoon
cartoon.desc: Ink outlines, flat colour, hard shadows and buttons that bounce.

mono.name: Monochrome
mono.desc: Black, white and one red. Grid, hairlines and typography do the rest.

deco.name: Art Deco
deco.desc: Gold on navy, a sunburst on the wall, capitals set wide.

riso.name: Riso Press
riso.desc: Duplicator print: halftone screen, paper grain, ink that lands off register.

discord.name: Late Night
discord.desc: Deep blue-slate in layers, one indigo accent, everything softly rounded.

spotify.name: Night Player
spotify.desc: Near-black with lifted cards and a single vivid green doing all the work.

appearanceDesc: Pick a theme and language for your panel.
languageHelp: Choose Auto to follow your system language.
themeError: Couldn't change your theme. Try again.
languageError: Couldn't change your language. Try again.

storage.title: Storage
storage.desc: How much of your allowance you're using.

account.title: Account
account.desc: Your public identity and upload defaults.
account.userCodeHint: The prefix in every share link:
account.privateByDefaultHelp: New uploads start unlisted - only people with the link can view them.
account.copyRawHelp: After uploading, copy the direct file link instead of the viewer page.
account.saveError: Couldn't save your profile. Try again.

tag.title: Your tag
tag.desc: The first part of every link you share. Change it whenever you like.
tag.label: Tag
tag.previewLabel: Your links will look like this
tag.aliasTitle: Links you already shared keep working
tag.aliasBody: Your old tag is kept forever and still resolves, so every link already out there - in Discord, in documents, in bookmarks - carries on working. Nobody else can ever claim it.
tag.skipLabel: Drop the tag from new links
tag.skipHelp: New uploads get links like host/screenshot.png instead of host/tag/screenshot.png.
tag.skipWarning: Admins only. Tagless links live in the same namespace as the app's own pages, so reserved names (/login, /dashboard, …) stay off limits. Files uploaded earlier keep their current links.
tag.skipEnabled: New links will skip the tag.
tag.skipDisabled: New links will include the tag.

issue.too-long: Tags can be at most 32 characters.
issue.charset: Use letters, digits, dashes and underscores only, starting with a letter or digit.
issue.reserved: That name is reserved by the app.
issue.retired: That tag belonged to another account and can't be reused.
issue.error: Couldn't save your tag. Try again.

naming.title: How new files are named
naming.desc: The second part of your links. Applies to new uploads only - files you have already shared keep the name they were given.
naming.label: Naming style
naming.previewLabel: A new upload would look like this
naming.existingSafe: Changing this never touches a link you have already shared: every file stores the name it was created with.
naming.error: Couldn't save your naming style. Try again.

words.name: Words
words.hint: funny-cat, ineffable-guitar - easy to say out loud

custom.name: Custom pattern
custom.hint: Build your own from the tokens below

words.label: How many words
words.pool: About {pool} different names at this setting.

chars.label: How many characters
chars.unambiguousBody: 0, O and o are left out, and so are 1, l and I - the pairs people actually get wrong when reading a link off a screen or repeating it over the phone.
chars.growWarning: If codes of this length ever run out, new uploads automatically get one character more. Nothing breaks and nothing is refused.

token.words2: Two words - use words3 or words4 for more
token.rand5: Five random characters - any length from 1 up
token.name: Original filename, cleaned up

domain.title: Link domain
domain.desc: Which address your links are built from. This app answers on all of them.
domain.label: Generate my links on
domain.previewLabel: Your links will look like this
domain.safeTitle: Every link you have shared keeps working
domain.safeBody: All {count} addresses point at this same app and serve the same files, permanently. Switching only changes what NEW links say - nothing already out there stops working, now or ever.
domain.sharexBody: ShareX stores the address inside its config file, so it will not pick this up on its own. Grab a fresh one from <link>ShareX and API</link> after changing this.
domain.error: Couldn't change the link domain. Try again.

uploadFolder.title: Default folder
uploadFolder.desc: Where new uploads land when you don't pick a folder yourself.
uploadFolder.label: New uploads go to
uploadFolder.help: Applies to web uploads and ShareX alike. You can still move files afterwards.
uploadFolder.emptyHelp: Create a folder first and it will show up here.
uploadFolder.error: Couldn't change the default folder. Try again.

security.title: Security
security.passwordSignOutNote: Changing your password signs out all other devices.
security.passwordTooShort: New password must be at least 8 characters.
security.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other sessions were signed out.

defaultPassword.title: Password-protect new files
defaultPassword.desc: Every file you upload from now on gets this password, from the panel and from ShareX alike.
defaultPassword.saved: Default password saved. New uploads will use it.
defaultPassword.disabled: Default password turned off. New uploads will be unprotected.
defaultPassword.tooShort: The default password needs at least 4 characters.
defaultPassword.saveError: Couldn't save the default password. Try again.
defaultPassword.warningTitle: Changing this password has two effects
defaultPassword.warningBody: Everything you share from now on asks for the new password, including from people who ticked "remember me for 30 days". Files you have already shared keep the password they were sent with, so those links carry on working exactly as before.
defaultPassword.appliesNote: A password you set on a single file is never touched by this.
defaultPassword.applyExisting: Also change the {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} already using it
defaultPassword.applyExistingOn: Those links stay the same but start asking for the new password. Anyone you sent them to needs to be told.
defaultPassword.applyExistingOff: Files already shared keep the password they were sent with, so those links carry on working exactly as before.
defaultPassword.warningRewrite: This rewrites the password on {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} you have already shared. Their links do not change, but the old password stops working everywhere, including for people who ticked "remember me for 30 days". It cannot be undone: to go back you would have to type the previous password in again from memory.
defaultPassword.confirmRewrite: Yes, change {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}
defaultPassword.savedFiles: Saved. {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} switched to the new password.
defaultPassword.clearedFiles: Default password turned off. {count, plural, one {# file is} other {# files are}} no longer protected.
defaultPassword.offTitle: What about the files already shared?
defaultPassword.offBody: {count, plural, one {# file is} other {# files are}} protected with your default password. Turning the setting off always stops NEW uploads being protected. Choose what happens to those.
defaultPassword.offStrip: Unprotect {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}
defaultPassword.embedTitle: Discord will not turn these links into pictures
defaultPassword.embedBody: A protected file shows no preview in Discord, Twitter or Telegram, and that is the point: Discord copies previews onto its own servers and re-hosts them publicly, so an embed would hand out the file to everyone in the channel without the password. Files you leave unprotected still preview normally.

security.twoFactorDesc: Require a one-time code from an authenticator app when you sign in.
security.verifyEmailDesc: We recommend confirming your email before enabling 2FA so you can recover access.
security.scanTitle: 1. Scan this QR with your authenticator
security.scanDesc: Open Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy, or similar and scan the code below. Can't scan? Enter the setup key manually instead.
security.qrAlt: QR code for two-factor authenticator setup
security.saveBackupDesc: Each code works once if you lose access to your authenticator.
security.enterCodeDesc: Type the current code shown in your authenticator app.
security.enableError: Couldn't start 2FA setup. Check your password.
security.enterSixDigit: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator.
security.codeMismatch: That code didn't match. Try the latest one.
security.protectedNote: Your account is protected with an authenticator app.
security.confirmPasswordDesc: Enter your password to begin setting up two-factor authentication.
security.disableDesc: Enter your password to turn off two-factor authentication. Your account will be less secure.

background.title: Wallpaper
background.desc: Put an image behind your panel. Everyone opening your links sees it too, the same way they see your skin.
background.dimHelp: How far the skin covers the image. Higher means calmer background and sharper text.
background.note: Up to 12 MB. The image is re-encoded to WebP on upload, which also strips its EXIF data, so a photo does not publish the place it was taken.
background.tooLarge: That image is over 12 MB. Pick a smaller one.
background.badType: That file is not an image we can use. Try PNG, JPEG, WebP or AVIF.
background.uploadError: Could not save the wallpaper. Try again.
background.removeError: Could not remove the wallpaper. Try again.
background.dimError: Could not save the veil setting.
background.dimWarning: At this setting text can be hard to read over a busy image. Raise the veil if the panel starts to feel noisy.

avatar.title: Avatar
avatar.desc: The picture shown next to your name, in your panel and wherever else your account appears. Animated GIFs stay animated.
avatar.sizesNote: Drawn at these sizes in the sidebar and the top bar.
avatar.removed: Avatar removed. Your initials are back.
avatar.note: Up to 8 MB. The image is re-encoded to a 256 px square WebP, which also strips its EXIF data, so a photo does not publish the place it was taken.
avatar.visibility: Your avatar is public: anyone who can see your links or your galleries can see it. Picking one of your files copies it into a small square, so the file itself stays exactly as private as it was.
avatar.tooLarge: That image is over 8 MB. Pick a smaller one.
avatar.tooManyPixels: That image declares more pixels than we will decode. Pick a smaller one.
avatar.badType: That file is not an image we can use. Try PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF or GIF.
avatar.busy: The server is busy converting images right now. Try again in a moment.
avatar.uploadError: Could not save the avatar. Try again.
avatar.removeError: Could not remove the avatar. Try again.
avatar.pickMissing: That file is no longer available.
avatar.degradedFrames: The animation was too long, so the avatar was saved as a still image.
avatar.degradedPixels: The animation was too large to re-encode, so the avatar was saved as a still image.
avatar.degradedSize: The animation came out too heavy for an avatar, so it was saved as a still image.
avatar.pickerDesc: Any image you have already uploaded. A small square copy is made, so deleting the file later will not remove your avatar.
avatar.pickerTooLarge: This file is too large to use as an avatar.
avatar.pickerPrivateNote: A private file can be used. Only the small square becomes visible, never the file.

duplicates.title: Find duplicates
duplicates.desc: Look through the files you have already uploaded for copies of the very same file, and offer to clear them out.
duplicates.byChecksumTitle: Matched by checksum, never by name
duplicates.byChecksumBody: Two files count as copies only when their contents hash to the same sha256. Names are ignored, so twenty unrelated screenshots called image.png stay twenty files, while clip.mp4 next to clip (1).mp4 is found.
duplicates.idle: Nothing scanned yet. The scan only reads your library, it never removes anything on its own.
duplicates.none: No duplicates found. Every file you have is one of a kind.
duplicates.trashSelected: Move {count, plural, one {# copy} other {# copies}} to trash
duplicates.trashNote: Anything removed here goes to the trash, where it can be restored for 30 days.
duplicates.unchecksummed: {count, plural, one {# file has} other {# files have}} no checksum stored, so this scan cannot see them. Large uploads get theirs the first time something reads the whole file, so this number falls on its own.
duplicates.truncated: Showing the {shown} biggest sets out of {total}. Clear these and scan again to see the rest.
duplicates.selection: {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} selected, {size}
duplicates.emptiedWarning: {count, plural, one {One set has} other {# sets have}} every copy selected, so nothing would be kept.
duplicates.copies: {count, plural, one {# copy} other {# copies}} of the same file
duplicates.noCopyKept: Every copy in this set is selected, so none will be left behind.
duplicates.trashed: {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} moved to the trash, {size}. The space comes back when the trash is emptied.

page.title: Duplicate files
page.subtitle: Copies of the very same file, found by checksum. Nothing leaves your library until you say so.

duplicates.keepOnlyAria: Keep only {filename} and mark the other copies for the trash
duplicates.keptNote: These stay exactly where they are and stop counting towards the reminder. The next count starts from what is left.
duplicates.keptToast: {count, plural, one {# set} other {# sets}} will not be counted or brought up again.
duplicates.keptExcluded: {count, plural, one {# set is} other {# sets are}} kept on purpose, so {size} is left out of the count.
duplicates.countAgainToast: {count, plural, one {# set is} other {# sets are}} being counted again.
duplicates.moreCopies: Showing {shown} of {total} copies in this set. Clear these and scan again to see the rest.

reminder.body: You have {count, plural, one {# duplicate file} other {# duplicate files}} taking up {size}.

error.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
error.failed: That did not finish. Try again in a moment.
error.malformed: That selection is out of date. Scan again.
error.too-many: Too many files in one go. Clear some of them first, then scan again.

sessions.title: Devices and sessions
sessions.desc: Everywhere your account is signed in right now. Sign out anything you do not recognise.
sessions.currentHint: This is the session you are using now. To end it, use Sign out in the account menu.
sessions.confirmBody: This ends {count, plural, one {# other session} other {# other sessions}}. Anyone signed in there, you on your other devices included, has to sign in again. The session you are using now stays open.
sessions.confirmCta: Sign out {count, plural, one {# session} other {# sessions}}
sessions.renewNote: "Renewed" is not a last-seen time. A session stamps itself at most once a day, when it renews itself, and nothing here records individual requests.
sessions.ipNote: The address is shown exactly as the server received it. We never look up a city or a country from it, so nothing on this screen is guessing where you were.
sessions.revokedOthers: {count, plural, one {# other session} other {# other sessions}} signed out.
sessions.revokeError: Couldn't sign that session out. Try again.
sessions.currentRefused: That is the session you are using. Use Sign out in the account menu to end it.
